scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @conducted/sidecar build && pnpm --filter @conducted/desktop tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.test: bun scripts/check-runtime.ts && bun scripts/with-run-dir.ts pnpm run test:all
scripts.test:all: pnpm -r --no-bail test; packages=$?; bun test ./scripts ${CONDUCTED_TEST_REPORTS:+--reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=$CONDUCTED_TEST_REPORTS/scripts.xml}; scripts=$?; exit $((packages || scripts))
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm guards && pnpm stubs
